name: Connected GitHub token publishing
capability: Explicit GitHub Token Connection bindings for the existing GitData publisher and UTF-8 Contents create/update publisher. Preserves observed file preimages, actual returned commit and blob identities, expected-head merges, raw provider envelopes and complete immutable source readback.
next_gap: Contents deletion and existing-ref advancement need their own compatible discovered bindings; the current token repository writer exposes POST, PUT and PATCH.
